data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 0.8m (2016: run-off deviation of GBP 1.1m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012, 2013 and 2014 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reserve movements on Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003
prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 0.8m relating to reserve movements on the 2012, 2013 and 2014 years of account on the Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003.

named_events.loss_description: High volume of North America catastrophe losses incurred during the period.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small favourable prior-year run-off of GBP 0.8m in 2017, arising wholly from reserve movements on the 2012-2014 Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003 (a release). The opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 was GBP 116.631m. The release appears driven by favourable claims development on those quota-share exposures and reinsurance-related movements; the report also notes elevated North America catastrophe activity in 2017 that adversely affected current-year claims.
raw_causal_phrases: A favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 0.8m (2016: run-off deviation of GBP 1.1m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012, 2013 and 2014 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003.
The syndicate incurred a net loss ratio of 89.4% (2016: 65.4%). The increase in the loss ratio is primarily due to the high volume of North America catastrophe losses incurred during the period.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development amount (GBP 0.8m favourable) is taken from the movement note (note 8) which does not explicitly label the figure as gross or net; therefore this has been treated as the reported prior-year run-off. A gross claims development triangle is present in the report but includes an aggregate '2012 & Prior' column which complicates a full gross PYD calculation; consequently the explicit movement note was used. Confidence for the PYD figure is reduced due to the lack of an explicit gross label.
